summary: Viatris Inc. filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with Pacira BioSciences and its subsidiary Peach Purchaser Sub Inc., under which Viatris will acquire Pacira via a tender offer for all outstanding shares at $36.50 per share in cash, structured as a two-step merger under Section 251(h) of the Delaware General Corporation Law. The offer is subject to a majority-of-outstanding-shares minimum tender condition, antitrust clearance, and other customary terms, with no target shareholder vote required.
